speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your symptoms of fatigue, leg swelling, and weight loss, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing these issues and if you have noticed any shortness of breath?

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of heart failure or liver disease, and have you noticed any abdominal distension or pain? Also, is the swelling pitting, meaning does it leave an indentation when you press on it?

speaker: Doctor
text: A normal biopsy result is unexpected and suggests the initial mass may not be malignant or the sample missed the lesion. speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of 4+ protein and fatty casts in your urine strongly suggests nephrotic syndrome, which explains your leg swelling and fatigue. Given the lung mass, I suspect a paraneoplastic syndrome or a secondary glomerular disease, so I will request a renal ultrasound to evaluate the kidneys. REQUEST TEST: Renal_Ultrasound.

speaker: Doctor
text: The combination of a lung mass and nephrotic syndrome (proteinuria, fatty casts, edema) in a smoker is classic for a paraneoplastic glomerular disease, most likely Membranous Nephropathy secondary to lung cancer. DIAGNOSIS READY: Lung Cancer with secondary Membranous Nephropathy
